name: deskcue
description: Local-first control panel for CLI AI agents.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @deskcue/daemon
scripts.doctor: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/cli && npm run start --workspace @deskcue/cli -- doctor
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev:daemon" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:daemon:watch: nodemon --exitcrash --watch apps/daemon/src --watch packages/protocol/src --watch packages/adapters/src --ext ts,json --exec "npm run build:packages && npm run dev:daemon"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @deskcue/protocol && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/adapters
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/cli && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/web
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace @deskcue/protocol && npm run test --workspace @deskcue/adapters
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run lint --workspace @deskcue/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run lint:fix --workspace @deskcue/web
scripts.verify: npm run verify:packages && npm run verify:daemon && npm run verify:cli && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:repository
scripts.verify:packages: npm run test --workspace @deskcue/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/protocol && npm run test --workspace @deskcue/adapters && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/adapters
scripts.verify:daemon: npm run lint --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/daemon && npm run test --workspace @deskcue/daemon
scripts.verify:cli: npm run test --workspace @deskcue/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @deskcue/cli && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/cli
scripts.verify:web: npm run test:release --workspace @deskcue/web && npm run build --workspace @deskcue/web && npm run build:embed --workspace @deskcue/web
scripts.verify:repository: npm run version:check && npm run audit:production && npm run audit:all && git diff --check
